audit.whatIsWrong: The chart (Ziggs, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Ziggs, Kayle, Kayle) contradicts the already-audited mirror (kayle__ziggs), which settled on Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle.
audit.why: Kayle is at her weakest through levels 1-2, not level 1 only; and level 6 belongs to her because Divine Judgment invalidates Ziggs' execute — the current chart hands level 6 to Ziggs.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 flipped to match the mirror, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet: sequencingCues 0), and the stage whys were generic Ziggs boilerplate that ignored Kayle's spikes.
audit.why: Radiant Blast 12s at rank 1, Celestial Blessing 15s and Divine Judgment 160s at rank 1 are the three clocks this lane runs on.
audit.corrected: phases[2..4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Divine Judgment's invulnerability eats the Mega Inferno Bomb outright, that Radiant Blast reduces resistances, or that Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Ziggs' only kill button is a 120s ultimate; opening with it into an up Divine Judgment wastes the lane's whole win condition. The E reset is the wind-up tell for stepping back.
audit.corrected: Stated the R-eats-R interaction in phases[4].why and report[5]; the resistance shred in phases[2].why; the Starfire reset tell in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s and no Grievous Wounds timing appears anywhere.
audit.why: missingInteractions needs-antiheal for this pairing; Ziggs' whole plan is chip damage, which her W undoes.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal buy added to phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Kayle can't read the angle.
edits.after: Radiant Blast reaches 900 and shreds resistances on a 12s cooldown — poke back on it, and lay E behind you to break her step-up.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Kayle below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track Divine Judgment (Invuln) before every step-up.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s, so chip alone stalls — buy Grievous Wounds and trade in bursts rather than drips to hold her low.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Divine Judgment makes its target invulnerable — it eats your 120s Mega Inferno Bomb outright, so never open a kill with R here.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Divine Judgment, 160s at rank 1, makes its target invulnerable and eats your R outright — bait it, then commit. Her W heals every 15s.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Satchel like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — invulnerability eats your execute, so bait it out, then kill inside that window. - Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1 and shreds your resistances. - Celestial Blessing heals every 15s: bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: That is Kayle’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her Starfire Spellblade wind-up is the tell — step back on the animation, not the cast.

edits.before: Level 3 E Hexplosive Minefield walls her off farm entirely.
edits.after: Level 3 your minefield zones her, but Radiant Blast pokes back.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your poke keeps her starved and far from her scaling spikes.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 her 15s Celestial Blessing heal undoes chip between trades.
